listing.description_html:
40 adorable axolotls are waiting for your colors!

Axolotls are the cutest animals in the water, and kids ages 4 to 8 love them. Inside you will find happy axolotls swimming, eating snacks, playing sports, having birthday parties and exploring the ocean. Every page has big, bold lines and simple shapes that are easy to color.

  • 40 unique kawaii illustrations
  • Single sided pages so markers never bleed onto the next picture
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch format
  • Perfect gift for birthdays, holidays, road trips and quiet time

Screen free fun that builds creativity and fine motor skills. Add it to your cart today!
